CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_categories (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,name_ar VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_authors (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,name_ar VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,bio TEXT NOT NULL,bio_ar TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_articles (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,author_id VARCHAR(64),category_id VARCHAR(64),featured INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX journal_editorial(updated_at,id),INDEX journal_category(category_id),INDEX journal_author(author_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_translations (article_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,locale VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,slug VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,summary TEXT NOT NULL,content MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,publish_at VARCHAR(40),published_at VARCHAR(40),data TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(article_id,locale),UNIQUE KEY journal_slug(locale,slug),INDEX journal_public(locale,status,publish_at,published_at))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_redirects (locale VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,slug VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,article_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(locale,slug))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_media (upload_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,article_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,locale VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,INDEX journal_media_article(article_id,locale))
